title: Quick Lunch: Cheesy Spinach Melts
subtitle: with Lemon and Spring Onion
description: Take a break from the daily grind and refuel with our quick lunch specials. Simmer spinach in an easy white sauce, pile onto baguettes and sprinkle over herby grated cheese. A quick flash under the grill and lunch is served!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the grill to medium-high. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Thinly slice the spring onion. Cut half the lemon into wedges. Coarsely grate the cheese. Combine the cheese and country seasoning in a bowl.

Cook spinach: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Cook the spring onion, stirring, for 30 secs or until softened. Add the spinach and 1½ tbs water, cover and cook for 1-2 mins until the spinach is wilted. Add 1 tbs plain flour, reduce the heat to medium and cook, uncovered, stirring, for 1-2 mins until the flour is golden.

Make sauce: Gradually add 80ml (⅓ cup) milk to the pan, stirring constantly to prevent lumps forming (see Kitchen 101). Bring to a simmer and cook, stirring, for a further 3 mins or until thickened. Stir in 1 tsp dijon mustard. Remove the pan from the heat.
Toast bread: Meanwhile, cut the baguettes in half. Put on the lined tray, cut side up, and grill for 2-3 mins until lightly toasted.

Grill melts and serve up: Top the toasted baguettes with the creamed spinach and cheese mixture. Grill for 5 mins or until the cheese is melted and golden. Divide the cheesy spinach melts among plates and serve with the lemon wedges for squeezing over. Enjoy!

Kitchen 101: The trick to a silky smooth sauce is to add the milk gradually while stirring continuously. Add a little milk and stir until smooth, then add a little more. Continue stirring and adding small amounts until fully combined.
